scope: Deliver one-time local setup/status/uninstall: native Claude user mod autoload and verified interactive Codex wrapping, with unsupported native commands/flags forwarded unchanged without warming.

acceptance.description: Preserve the existing 112 controlled watcher policy assertions, including strict threshold, idle timing and four-hour user budget.
Read-only plan, idempotent isolated native install/status/uninstall and preservation of unrelated entries/external edits.
Plain native Claude autoload, independent session metadata and rollover/reload recovery without stale measurements.
Verified original interactive command forms automatically warm only their owned native TUI/thread; unsupported forms pass through.
Unsupported argv/stdio/cwd/exit stay exact; supported model/cwd/approval/sandbox semantics and transport-only changes have real proof.
Real repeatable artifacts, source identities, owned cleanup, unchanged personal files, opt-in defaults and reversible setup documentation.
